questions.questionHtml: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is here is:

1st number - 2nd number = 118

Option (1): 727 : 609

Now, follow the logic:

727 – 609 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

Option (2): 373 : 255

Now, follow the logic:

373 - 255 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

Option (3): 191 : 177

Now, follow the logic:

191 – 177 = 14

This option do not follow the pattern.

Option (4): 797 : 679

Now, follow the logic:

797 – 679 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

Hence, pair “191 : 177” is an odd one.

Alternate Method The logic followed here is:-

Sum of digits of first number - Sum of digits of second number = 1

1) In 727 : 609

Sum of digits of first number = 7 + 2 + 7 = 16

Sum of digits of second number = 6 + 0 + 9 = 15

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 16 - 15 = 1

2) In 373 : 255

Sum of digits of first number = 3 + 7 + 3 = 13

Sum of digits of second number = 2 + 5 + 5 = 12

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 13 - 12 = 1

3) In 191 : 177

Sum of digits of first number = 1 + 9 + 1 = 11

Sum of digits of second number = 1 + 7 + 7 = 15

Here, sum of digits of second number > Sum of digits of first number

Also, Sum of digits of second number - sum of digits of first number → 15 - 11 = 4

4) In 797 : 679

Sum of digits of first number = 7 + 9 + 7 = 23

Sum of digits of second number = 6 + 7 + 9 = 22

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 23 - 22 = 1

As can be seen clearly from the above that 191 : 177 doesn't follow the logic and is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "191 : 177".

questions.question: Alekhya was born a year after her mother's marriage. Her father is two years older than her mother and twenty-five years older than Alekhya, who is six years old at present. At what age was his mother married?
questions.questionHtml: Alekhya was born a year after her mother's marriage. Her father is two years older than her mother and twenty-five years older than Alekhya, who is six years old at present. At what age was his mother married?
questions.solution:
Given:

1) Alekhya is six years old at present.

So, Alekhys age = 6 year

2) Alekhya’s father twenty-five years older than Alekhya.

So, Alekhya’s father age = 25 + 6 = 31 years

3) Alekhya’s father is two years older than Alekhya’s mother.

So, Alekhya’s mother age = 31 - 2 = 29 years

4) Alekhya was born a year after her mother's marriage.

So, mother's marriage before = 6 + 1 = 7 years

5) Age of Alekhya’s mother at married.

29 – 7 = 22

Hence,  Alekhya’s mother age at married is “22”.

questions.question: Kala-azar disease is caused by ______.
questions.questionHtml: Kala-azar disease is caused by ______.
questions.solution: Kala-azar, also known as Dumdum fever, is caused by the parasitic protozoan Leishmania donovani, which belongs to the class Mastigophora or flagellata. The disease is transmitted through the bite of an infected sand fly (Phlebotomus). Leishmania donovani exhibits dimorphic and digenetic characteristics. Kala-azar can manifest in three forms: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (skin ulcers), Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis (ulcers in the mouth, throat, and nose, nosebleeds, breathing difficulties), and Visceral Leishmaniasis (weakness, weight loss, appetite loss, enlarged spleen, liver, lymph nodes, and decreased blood cell production).

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the leaders of the Santhal rebellion?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following was one of the leaders of the Santhal rebellion?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Sidhu Manjihi.

Key Points

  • Santhal Rebellion took place during Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856) tenure at Rajmahal hills (in Jharkhand) led by Sidhu Manjhi.
  • Santhal uprising took place during 1855-56.
  • The tyrannical British revenue system, usury practices, and the zamindari system in India made Santhal peoples annoyed, and two Santhal brothers Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu organized 10,000 Santhals and proclaimed a rebellion against the British.
  • The Santhals are the largest tribal group in India found in Jharkhand, WestBengal, and Odisha.
  • Santhal Rebellion:
    • It was a rebellion against both the British colonial authority and zamindars by the Santhal people.
    • Leaders: Sidhu, Kahnu, Chand, and Bhairav.
    • Location: Jharkhand.
    • The rebellion was suppressed and largely shadowed by other rebellions.
    • To quell rebellion British created Santhal Pargana and special laws were
      passed protecting them.

Additional Information

  • Britishers invited the Santhals to come and settle in Jharkhand promising land and economic amenities.
  • Thus Santhals from different states came to settle in today's Jharkhand.
  • Later zamindars dominated these areas as they collected taxes and lent money at very high rates which the people could not generally pay and their lands were forcibly taken.
  • This became the roots of the Santhal rebellion.
  • In a fierce encounter, Santhals were defeated as they were fighting with bows and arrows while Britishers had modern weapons.
  • Sidhu was caught in August 1855 and was hanged on a banyan tree at a place called Panchkathia.

questions.question: Nathu La Pass connects India with which of its neighbouring countries?
questions.questionHtml: Nathu La Pass connects India with which of its neighbouring countries?
questions.solution: The Nathu La Pass, located at 14,450 feet in the East Sikkim district, is a significant Himalayan pass connecting India with China's Tibet Autonomous Region. It is one of the highest motorable roads globally and part of the Old Silk Route. Nathu La, meaning 'listening ears' (Nathu) and 'pass' (La), was closed for nearly 40 years following a Tibetan uprising in 1959 and reopened in 2006. It serves as a vital trading border post and an official Border Personnel Meeting (BPM) Point, known for its scenic beauty. Other notable Himalayan passes include Zoji La, Banihal Pass, Shipki La, Bara-Lacha La, Mana Pass, and Niti Pass.

  • They belonged to the Jains.

    • Status: UNESCO World Heritage Site (1987).
    • The caves are carved from solid basalt rock.
    • It is a conglomeration of seven caves, out of which the most important is the Mahesa-murti cave.

questions.question: If 2 cos 2 θ - 5 cos θ + 2 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (sec θ + tan θ) is:
questions.questionHtml: If 2 cos<sup>2</sup> θ - 5 cos θ + 2 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (sec θ + tan θ) is:

Given:

2 cos2 θ - 5 cos θ + 2 = 0

0° < θ < 90°

Concept used:

Middle Term Factor Method

Tanα = Sinα/Cosα 

Calculation:

Let Cosθ be P

Now putting Cos θ = P in the given expression,

2 P2- 5 P + 2 = 0

⇒ (2p - 1) (P - 2) = 0

Now, We can't take (P - 2) = 0 because Cos θ is always less than 1.

Now, (2p - 1) = 0

⇒ P = 1/2

⇒ Cos θ = Cos 60°

⇒ θ = 60°

Now, sec 60° = 2

So, tan 60° = sin60°/cos60° = √3

Now, (sec θ + tan θ) = (sec 60° + tan 60°) 

⇒ (2 + √ 3)

∴ The required value of (sec θ + tan θ) is (2 + √ 3).

questions.question: Points A, D, C, B and E are concyclic, If ∠AEC = 50° and ∠ABD = 30°. then what is the measure (in degrees) of ∠CBD?

Given:

Points A, D, C, B, and E are concyclic

∠AEC = 50°

∠ABD = 30°

Concept used:

Angles formed from two points on the circumference are equal to other angles, in the same arc, formed from those two points.  

Calculation:

AD & AC are joined.

Now,

∠AEC = 50° and ∠AEC = ∠ABC = 50°

∠ABD = 30°

Now,

∠ABC = ∠ABD + ∠CBD

⇒ 50° = 30° + ∠CBD

⇒ ∠CBD = 50° - 30°

⇒ ∠CBD = 20°

∴ The measure of ∠CBD is 20°.

Given:

\(\frac{x}{y}+\frac{y}{x}=2\)

Concept used:

(x - y)2 = (x2 - 2xy + y2)

Calculation:

x/y + y/x = 2

⇒ {(x × x) + (y × y)}/(x × y) = 2

⇒ (x2 + y2)/xy = 2

⇒ (x2 + y2) = 2xy      ----(1)

Now,

(x - y)

⇒ √(x - y)2

⇒ √(x2 - 2xy + y2)

⇒ √(x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ √(2xy - 2xy)      (From (1))

⇒ 0

∴ The required value of (x - y) is 0.

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill an empty tank in 10 hours and 16 hours respectively. They are opened alternately for 1 hour each, opening pipe B first, in how many hours, will the empty tank be filled?
questions.questionHtml: Two pipes A and B can fill an empty tank in 10 hours and 16 hours respectively. They are opened alternately for 1 hour each, opening pipe B first, in how many hours, will the empty tank be filled?
questions.solution:
Given:

Pipe A fills the empty tank in 10 hours

Pipe B fills the empty tank in 16 hours

Concept Used:

Total work = LCM of time taken by each pipe

Calculation:

LCM of 16 and 10 = 80

Let total work be 80 units

Pipe A does = 80/10 = 8 units per hour

Pipe B does = 80/16 = 5 units per hour

Now,

Pipe B & A fill the tank in two hour

⇒ (5 + 8) units

⇒ 13 units

Now,

Each B & A will keep filling the tank for = (80/13) ≈ 6 hours 

After (6 × 2) = 12 hours, the tank will be filled by (13 × 6) = 78 units. 

2 units are yet to be filled

On, 13th hour B will be opened. 

It will take 2/5 hour for B to fill the remaining tank entirely.

Total time = 12 + 2/5 = \(12\frac{2}{5}\) hours 

∴ The empty tank will be filled in \(12\frac{2}{5}\) hours.

questions.question: What is the sum of the digits of the largest five digit number which is divisible by 5, 35, 39 and 65?
questions.questionHtml: What is the sum of the digits of the largest five digit number which is divisible by 5, 35, 39 and 65?
questions.solution:
Given:

Numbers are 5, 35, 39 and 65

Concept used:

The smallest number that is divisible by a series of numbers is their LCM.

Calculation:

LCM (5, 35, 39, 65) = 1365

Largest five-digit number = 99999

The approximate quotient when 99999 is divided by 1365

⇒ 99999 ÷ 1365 ≈ 73

The largest five-digit number which is divisible by 1365

⇒ 73 × 1365

⇒ 99645

So, the largest five-digit number which is divisible by 5, 35, 39 & 65 is 99645

Now,

The sum of digits of 99645 = 9 + 9 + 6 + 4 + 5 = 33

∴ The sum of the digits of the largest five digit number which is divisible by 5, 35, 39 and 65 is 33.

questions.question: The angles of a Triangle are in AP (arithmetic progression). If measure of the smallest angle is 50° less than that of the largest angle, then find the largest angle (in degrees).
questions.questionHtml: The angles of a Triangle are in AP (arithmetic progression). If measure of the smallest angle is 50° less than that of the largest angle, then find the largest angle (in degrees).
questions.solution:
Given:

The angles of a Triangle are in AP

the smallest angle is 50° less than that of the largest angle

Concept used:

All three angles of a triangle sum up to 180°

Three elements of arithmetic progression can be supposed as (a - d), a, (a + d) where a is the first term and d is the common difference

Calculation:

Let the smallest angle of the triangle be (A - D)°

Now,

The second-largest angle of the triangle = A°

The largest angle of the triangle = (A + D)°

According to the question,

(A + D)° - 50°  = (A - D)°

⇒ (A + D)° - (A - D)° = 50°

⇒ 2D = 50°

⇒ D = 25°

Now,

(A - D)° + A° + (A + D)° = 180° 

⇒ 3A° = 180° 

⇒ A° = 60° 

The largest angle of the triangle = (A + D)° = (60 + 25) = 85°

∴ The largest angle of the triangle is 85°.

A + B - √14C

Given:

Population become after increment 18428

Concept used:

The Elimination Method for solving linear equations

Calculation:

Let the present male & female population be M & F respectively.

According to the question,

M + F = 15280      ....(1)

Then,

After increment male population = M + M × 1/4 = 5M/4

After increment Female population = F + F × 3/20 = 23F/20

questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of monthly incomes of A and B is 4 ∶ 5

The ratio of monthly expenditures is 3 ∶ 8

The income of A is equal to the expenditure of B

Concept used:

Savings = Income - Expenditure

Calculation:

Let the common ratio of monthly incomes & expenditures be P & Q respectively.

Now,

Monthly income of A = 4P

Monthly income of B = 5P

Now,

Monthly expenditures of A = 3Q

Monthly expenditures of B = 8Q

According to the question,

4P = 8Q

⇒ P = 2Q

Now,

Monthly income of A = 4 × 2Q = 8Q

Monthly income of B = 5 × 2Q = 10Q

Now,

Monthly savings of A = (8Q - 3Q) = 5Q

Monthly savings of B = (10Q - 8Q) = 2Q

Ratio of the savings of A & B = 5Q : 2Q = 5 : 2

∴ The ratio of the savings of A & B is 5 : 2.

questions.questionHtml: Two circles of radii 18 cm and 16 cm intersect each other and the length of their common chord is 20 cm. What is the distance (in cm) between their centres?

Given:

The radius of the smaller circle = 16 cm

Length of the common chord = 20 cm

Concept used:

If two circles intersect in two points, prove that the line through their centers is a perpendicular bisector of the common chord.

AB is the common chord and C1C2 is the distance between the centres of the circles.

AC1 = 18 cm

AC2 = 16 cm

AB = 20 cm

AD = 20/2 = 10 cm

From ΔAC1D,

(AC1)2 = (C1​D)2 + (AD)2

⇒ 182 = (C1​D)2 + 102

⇒ (C1​D)2 = 324 - 100

⇒ (C1​D)2 = 224

⇒ (C1​D)2 = 14 × 16

⇒ C1D = 4√14

From ΔAC2D,

questions.question: if cot θ = \(\frac{15}{8}\) , θ is an acute angle, then find the value of \(\rm \frac{(1-cos\theta)(2+2cos\theta)}{(2-2sin\theta)(1+sin\theta)}\) .
questions.questionHtml: if cot θ = \(\frac{15}{8}\), θ is an acute angle, then find the value of \(\rm \frac{(1-cos\theta)(2+2cos\theta)}{(2-2sin\theta)(1+sin\theta)}\).
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Simplify the expression using the identity (1 − cos2 θ) = sin2 θ and (1 − sin2 θ) = cos2 θ.

Expression = [2(1 − cos θ)(1 + cos θ)] ÷ [2(1 − sin θ)(1 + sin θ)] = (1 − cos2 θ) ÷ (1 − sin2 θ).

This simplifies directly to sin2 θ ÷ cos2 θ = tan2 θ.

Since cot θ = 15/8, then tan θ = 8/15.

Result = (8/15)2 = 64/225.

∴ The correct answer is 64/225.

Alternate Method

Given: cot θ = 15/8, where θ is an acute angle.

In a right-angled triangle, cot θ = Base / Perpendicular.

Using Pythagoras Theorem: H2 = P2 + B2 ⇒ H2 = 82 + 152 = 64 + 225 = 289 ⇒ H = 17.

Formula Used: (a − b)(a + b) = a2 − b2

Expression = ((1 − cos θ)(2 + 2 cos θ)) / ((2 − 2 sin θ)(1 + sin θ))

⇒ [2 × (1 − cos θ)(1 + cos θ)] / [2 × (1 − sin θ)(1 + sin θ)]

⇒ (1 − cos2 θ) / (1 − sin2 θ)

By trigonometric identities: 1 − cos2 θ = sin2 θ and 1 − sin2 θ = cos2 θ

⇒ sin2 θ / cos2 θ = tan2 θ

⇒ (1 / cot θ)2

⇒ (1 / (15/8))2 = (8/15)2

⇒ 64 / 225

∴ The correct answer is 64/225.

Additional Information

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

1. sin2 θ + cos2 θ = 1 | 2. 1 + tan2 θ = sec2 θ | 3. 1 + cot2 θ = cosec2 θ.

Reciprocal Relations

tan θ = 1 / cot θ, sec θ = 1 / cos θ, and cosec θ = 1 / sin θ.

Pythagorean Triplet

For a right-angled triangle with sides (8, 15, 17), the square of the largest side equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides (172 = 82 + 152).

questions.question: A boat can go 5 km upstream and \(7\frac{1}{2}\) km downstream in 45 minutes. It can also go 5 km downstream and 2.5 km Upstream in 25 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will it take to go 6 km downstream?
questions.questionHtml: A boat can go 5 km upstream and \(7\frac{1}{2}\) km downstream in 45 minutes. It can also go 5 km downstream and 2.5 km Upstream in 25 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will it take to go 6 km downstream?
questions.solution:
Given:

The boat takes 45 mins to go 5 km upstream and 7.5 km downstream.

The boat takes 25 mins to go 5 km downstream and 2.5 km upstream

Concept used:

When going downstream, the speed of the boat and the flow of the river are added to calculate the net speed.

When going upstream, we take the difference between the speed of the boat and the flow of the river as the net speed. 

Distance =  Time × Speed

Elimination method for solving linear equations

Calculation:

Let the speed of the boat and the flow of the riven be B & R respectively. (in Kilometer per hours i.e. kmph)

Now,

Upstream speed = B - R = 1/P (suppose)

Downstream speed = B + R = 1/Q (suppose)

45 mins = 3/4 hour

25 mins = 5/12 hour

According to the question,

5/(B - R) + 7.5/(B + R) = 3/4

⇒ 5P + 7.5Q = 3/4      ....(1)

According to the question,

2.5/(B - R) + 5/(B + R) = 5/12

⇒ 2.5P + 5Q = 5/12      ....(2)

Solving (1) & (2) we get,

Q = 1/30 i.e. 1/(B + R) = 30

Now,

B + R = 30

The net speed during downstream = 30kmph

Now,

Time taken to cover 6km downstream

⇒ 6/30 hour

⇒ 1/5 hour

⇒ 1/5 × 60 mins

⇒ 12 mins

∴ 12 mins will it take to go 6 km downstream.

questions.questionHtml: If \(\sqrt{x}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}=\sqrt{7}\), then the value of \(x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}\) is:
questions.solution:
Given: 

\(√{x}-\frac{1}{√{x}}=√{7}\)

Concept used:

(A + B)2 = A2 + 2AB + B2

(A - B)2 = A2 - 2AB + B2

Calculation:

\(√{x}-\frac{1}{√{x}}=√{7}\)

⇒ (√x - 1/√x)2 = (√7)2 (Squaring both side)

⇒ (√x)2 - (2 × √x × 1/√x) + (1/√x)2 = 7

⇒ (√x)2 - (2 × 1) + (1/√x)2 = 7

⇒ (x + 1/x)  = 7 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)  = 9

⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 92  (Squaring both side)

⇒ (x)2+ (2 × x × 1/x) + (1/x)2 = 92

⇒ (x)2 + (1/x)2 = 81 - 2

⇒ (x)2 + (1/x)2 = 79

∴ The required value of (x)2 + (1/x)2 is 79.

questions.question: Points P and Q are on the sides AB and BC respectively of a triangle ABC, right angled at B. If AQ = 11 cm, PC = 8 cm. and AC = 13 cm, then find the length (in cm) of PQ:
questions.questionHtml: Points P and Q are on the sides AB and BC respectively of a triangle ABC, right angled at B. If AQ = 11 cm, PC = 8 cm. and AC = 13 cm, then find the length (in cm) of PQ:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick 

In any right angled triange like above 

a = √(b2 + c2 - d2)

In the question, we have b = 11, c = 8 and d = 13

So, a = √(112 + 82 - 132) 

⇒ a = √16 = 4 cm

∴ PQ = 4 cm.

Alternate Method

Given:

ΔABC is a right-angled triangle at ∠B.

AQ = 11cm

PC = 8cm

AC = 13cm

Concept used: 

Pythagorean theorem states that the sum of the squares on the other two sides of a right-angled triangle is equal to the square on the hypotenuse (the side opposite the right angle)

Calculation:

Let the length of AB, BC, BQ & PB be T, S, x & y respectively.

Now,
ΔABC, ΔABQ, ΔBPC and ΔPBQ are all right-angled triangles. 

From ΔABC,

⇒ S2 + T2 = 132      ....(1)

From ΔABQ,

⇒ x2 + T2 = 112      ....(2)

From ΔBPC,

⇒ y2 + S2 = 82      ....(3)

From ΔPBQ,

⇒ x2 + y2 = PQ2      ....(4)

Adding (2) & (3),

x2 + T2 + y2 + S2 = 112 + 82

⇒ x2 + y2 + (S2 + T2) = 185

⇒ x2 + y2 = 185 - (S2 + T2) 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 185 - 169

⇒ x2 + y2 = 16

⇒ x2 + y2 = 42

⇒ PQ2 = 42 (From 4)

⇒ PQ = 4 (∵ Negative value can't be consider for length)

∴ The length of PQ is 4cm.

questions.question: Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. He was in the habit of stealing food from others. B. One night, the villagers decided to teach him a lesson and kept only rotten food in their kitchen. C. The culprit ended up eating the rotten food and fell sick. D. Once upon a time, there lived a man in a village.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. He was in the habit of stealing food from others.

B. One night, the villagers decided to teach him a lesson and kept only rotten food in their kitchen.

C. The culprit ended up eating the rotten food and fell sick.

D. Once upon a time, there lived a man in a village.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DABC.'

Key Points

  • The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a man in a village". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
  • Sentence A will come after D as it is giving information about the habit of the man (stealing from others).
  • Sentence B will come after A as it is explaining what the villagers decided to do with the man one night (they decided to keep rotten food for the man).
  • The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it is giving information about what finally happened with the man after eating rotten food.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: Once upon a time, there lived a man in a village. He was in the habit of stealing food from others. One night, the villagers decided to teach him a lesson and kept only rotten food in their kitchen. The culprit ended up eating the rotten food and fell sick.

Hint

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
       

Hinglish

  • वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक गांव में एक आदमी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है।
  • वाक्य A, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह आदमी की आदत (दूसरों से चोरी) के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।
  • वाक्य B, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह समझा रहा है कि ग्रामीणों ने एक रात उस आदमी के साथ क्या करने का फैसला किया (उन्होंने आदमी के लिए सड़ा हुआ भोजन रखने का फैसला किया)।
  • वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह इस बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है कि आखिरकार सड़ा हुआ खाना खाने के बाद आदमी के साथ क्या हुआ।

Key Points

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the past simple tense.
  • When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject ''Shiva'' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''a letter'' becomes the subject.
  • The active format "V2 (wrote)" should be converted into the passive format "was + V3 (written)".
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

TENSE ACTIVE PASSIVE PASSIVE CONVERSION
Present Simple He plays football am/is/are + V3 Football is played by him
Present Continuous He is playing football am/is/are + being +V3 Football is being played by him
Present Perfect He has played football Has/have + been+ V3 Football has been played by him
Present Perfect Continuous He has been playing football Not used and unusual. Not used and unusual
Past Simple He played football Was/were + V3 Football was played by him
Past Continuous He was playing football Was/were + being + V3 Football was being played by him
Past Perfect He had played football Had + been + V3 Football had been played by him
Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Simple He will play football Will + be + V3 Football will be played by him
Future Continuous He will be playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Perfect He will have played football Will have been + V3 Football will have been played by him
Future Perfect Continuous He will have been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
 

 

Hinglish

  • Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
  • Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह past simple tense में है।
  • जब हम इस वाक्य को passive voice में बदलते हैं, तो active voice का subject 'Shiva', object बन जाता है और object 'a letter', subject बन जाता है।
  • Active format "V2 (wrote)" को passive format "was + V3 (written)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
  • यह past simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।
     

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'a.'

Key Points

  • In the given sentence ''English vocabulary has ___(1)___ remarkable range, flexibility, and adaptability'', the noun 'range' is not a specified noun.
    • The range is not specified.
  • 'A' and 'an' are indefinite articles, which means that they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.
    • We use 'a' before a consonant sound (here, remarkable) and we use 'an' before a vowel sound.
  • The definite article 'the' is used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular.
  • ''No article'' is used when we refer to general ideas, plurals, or uncountable nouns.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

So the complete passage is:- English vocabulary has (1) a remarkable range, flexibility, and adaptability. Thanks to the periods (2) of contact with foreign (3) languages and its readiness to (4) coin new words out of old elements. English seems to have far more words in its core (5) vocabulary than other languages.

Additional Information

There are three articles: a, an, and the. Articles are used before nouns or noun equivalents and are a type of adjective.

RULES COUNT NOUNS NON-COUNT NOUNS
Specific identity not known a, an (no article)
Specific identity is known the the
All things or things in general (no article) (no article)
 

Hinglish

  • दिए गए वाक्य ''English vocabulary has ___(1)___ remarkable range, flexibility, and adaptability'' में, संज्ञा 'range' एक निर्दिष्ट संज्ञा नहीं है।
    • सीमा निर्दिष्ट नहीं है।
  • 'A' और 'an' अनिश्चितकालीन लेख हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि वे एक अनिर्दिष्ट संज्ञा को संदर्भित करते हैं, या पेश करते हैं।
    • हम एक व्यंजन ध्वनि (यहां, remarkable) से पहले 'a' का उपयोग करें, और हम एक स्वर ध्वनि से पहले 'an' का उपयोग करें।
  • निश्चित लेख 'the' का प्रयोग एकवचन और बहुवचन संज्ञाओं से पहले किया जाता है जब संज्ञा विशिष्ट या विशेष होती है।
  • जब हम सामान्य विचारों, बहुवचनों या बेशुमार संज्ञाओं का उल्लेख करते हैं तो ''No article'' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
